correctness.rationale: The Johnson harmonic decomposition and its multiplicities are independently available in Filmus Lemma 2.1 and Lemma 5.2. A pair-difference eigenfunction computation gives the exact coefficient formula. Direct binomial/Catalan coefficient extraction and monotonicity identify each extreme singular value; Stirling gives both asymptotic constants. The standalone checker tests the complete eigenlists of twelve concrete matrices and 447 larger arithmetic parameter sets. The finite checks supplement, not replace, the analytic proof.

value.rationale: The exact rank and stability of constant-weight principal Fourier interpolation are natural invariants. The balanced slice has half rank, one extra coordinate restores invertibility with sharp order sqrt(k) distortion, and a second increases conditioning by an asymptotic factor k/2; the precise Catalan and binomial constants identify worst harmonic sectors. This is structural rather than an arbitrary finite parameter list.
